# Visit Singapore

> > Official tourism guide to Singapore featuring cultural heritage sites, sustainable travel options, and diverse neighborhoods from Chinatown to Kampong Gelam.

Visit Singapore is the official destination marketing platform showcasing Singapore's attractions, neighborhoods, and travel experiences. The site highlights the city-state's multicultural heritage including Peranakan, Tamil Muslim, and Malay communities, alongside modern sustainable tourism initiatives and iconic landmarks.

## Key Topics

- Singapore tourism
- Cultural heritage sites
- Peranakan culture
- Islamic architecture
- Chinatown attractions
- Kampong Gelam
- Sultan Mosque
- Jamae Mosque
- Tamil Muslim heritage
- Straits Settlements history
- Sustainable travel
- Eco-friendly hotels
- Singapore landmarks
- Museum experiences
- Civic District

## Cultural Heritage & Museums

- [Peranakan Museum Singapore – Heritage, Culture & Art](https://www.visitsingapore.com/neighbourhood/featured-neighbourhood/civic-district/peranakan-museum): Peranakan Museum showcasing Straits-born culture in Civic District

## Religious & Historic Landmarks

- [Sultan Mosque (Masjid) Singapore | Kampong Gelam Landmark](https://www.visitsingapore.com/neighbourhood/featured-neighbourhood/kampong-gelam/sultan-mosque): Iconic Sultan Mosque in Kampong Gelam, heart of Muslim community
- [Jamae Mosque (Masjid Chulia) | Historic Gem in Singapore](https://www.visitsingapore.com/neighbourhood/featured-neighbourhood/chinatown/jamae-mosque-masjid-chulia): Historic Jamae Mosque in Chinatown featuring Tamil Muslim heritage

## Sustainable Travel Resources

- [Sustainable Hotels in Singapore | Green Certified Stays](https://www.visitsingapore.com/travel-tips/about-singapore/travel-sustainably/certified-eco-friendly-hotels): Guide to GSTC-certified eco-friendly hotels in Singapore
